answer_1.quote: Target-Oriented Dialogue (TOD) systems can assist users in accomplishing specific targets through interactive natural language conversations... The system will interact with the user and generate a response...

answer_2.quote: Our evaluations primarily focus on measuring the successful achievement of TOD targets... For the CraigslistBargain dataset... adopt Success Rate (SR)... Average Turn (AT)... Sell-to-List Ratio (SLR)... For the PersonaChat dataset... adopt Keyword Coverage Ratio (KCR)... edit distance (Dist.)... For the TopDial dataset... adopt Success Rate (SR)... Average Turn (AT)... we also evaluate the text quality... using reference-based metrics, including BLEU, word-level F1 (F1) and BERT Score...

answer_3.quote: we utilize the state-of-the-art LLM, GPT-4o, to provide an overall evaluation score (Ovr.) of the dialogue quality on a scale of 1 to 5... based on various criteria such as coherence, helpfulness, appropriateness, and target achievement...

answer_4.quote: To ensure the reliability of our evaluation results, we provide human evaluations on the CraigslistBargain dataset in Appendix H... we recruit 5 independent volunteer annotators... ask human evaluators to provide a pairwise comparison... on the following three criteria: • Persuasive: Which system is more persuasive... • Coherent: Which system is more on topic... • Overall: Which system is better...
answer_4.guideline: pairwise comparison on criteria: persuasive, coherent, overall
